title.zh: 合作社（第 97 条下的豁免）（第 4 号）命令 2012

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Co-operative Societies (Exemption under Section 97) (No. 4) Order 2012 and shall come into operation on 31st August 2012.

3.—(1) Subject to sub-paragraph (2), the NTUC Enterprise Co-operative Limited (“the NEC”) is exempted from section 16A of the Act.
(2) The NEC shall not provide any financial service other than the granting of loans to and the provision of security or guarantee in respect of the obligations of —
(a)any associated company, joint venture company or subsidiary company of any society; or
(b)any co-operative society in which the NEC holds at least 20% of the total number of shares therein.
4. The NEC is exempted from section 57(3) of the Act for a period of 3 years.
